# Daisy Weekly

> Weekly student matchmaking service in Montreal, Canada.

Daisy Weekly matches Montreal students with one thoughtful match every Wednesday. No swiping, no algorithms — just real connections on your campus.

## How It Works

1. Students create a profile (name, school, photo, preferences)
2. Every Wednesday at 6 PM, matches are released via SMS
3. If both students are interested, contact info and a suggested meeting spot are revealed

## Who It's For

- Students at McGill University, Concordia University, Université de Montréal, UQAM, HEC Montréal
- Students at 25+ CEGEPs across greater Montreal (Dawson, Vanier, Marianopolis, Brébeuf, etc.)
- Anyone tired of dating app swiping culture who wants intentional, weekly matchmaking

## Key Features

- Student-only: every member is verified through their school
- Weekly cadence: one match per week, every Wednesday
- Privacy-first: no public profiles, contact shared only on mutual match
- Campus-aware: suggests real meeting spots near both students' schools
- Free for students during launch
